notes: At five and twenty years every metric is unchanged; only contentRevision moved. That is the expected result and worth recording: the founding stock saturates K's provisioning multiplier in both builds, subsistence never goes short, and the knowledge metrics do not touch the economy. A gate that moved here would have meant the change reached further than intended. Untuned, and not a balance claim before 0.5.0. The universe these numbers describe is still degenerate, and this change moved which ways rather than removing them. Two items leave the list: library depth is no longer pinned near two distinct nodes, because scribing survives now that parchment and bread are different things; and universities the god funds now actually get finished, so completedUniversities is no longer identically one. What remains degenerate: the god is still passive in the two fast gates, so 400 of the 432 runs measure the simulation's own evolution and not play; ascension eligibility still opens by passive accumulation, so the ascension rate remains a statement about a clock; the scribable list is still cost-ordered, so the same cheap nodes are copied repeatedly; and several observation channels still saturate. Read every figure here as a vital sign of a build, not as a description of the finished game.
rationale: w29/city-and-supply-chain: the single materials scalar became three kinds (food, stone, vellum), and the wire from knowledge to the economy was connected for the first time. Every baseline in this repository was recorded against a build in which resourceYieldBonuses was a hardcoded empty array and advanceConstruction had no caller outside its own tests, so both economy primitives were unreachable by any path. Content also gained form yieldWeights and territory yieldPerLandUnit, which moves contentRevision and invalidates the provenance of all three files on its own. These numbers are a measurement of what this build did on this date and NOT a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids one before 0.5.0, every magnitude the change introduced is marked untuned, and nothing here has been tuned against a target.
